decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's established specialist-lighting, transport and standards-heavy engineering capabilities, and with strong in-house R&D and continued website presence management is likely to keep refining rather than withdraw it.

A general interior lighting luminaire sits at the core of the firm's existing knowledge base and application portfolio, so absorptive capacity is high and continued market presence points to a low likelihood of withdrawal.

A pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is closely related to the firm's mainstream building-lighting and optical-design expertise, making it easy for management to learn from market feedback and retain it.

Although marine searchlights are more niche than standard building luminaires, they still build on the firm's robust specialist-lighting capabilities, and the fact that this product remained listed while another marine searchlight disappeared suggests management sees enough fit and learning potential to keep it.
